SELECT w.id AS workation_id, w.region_id, w.start_date, w.end_date,
(SELECT SUM(b.target_amount) FROM budgets b JOIN expense_categories ec ON ec.id = b.expense_category_id WHERE b.workation_id = w.id AND b.budget_type = 'WORK' AND ec.code = 'ACCOMMODATION') AS accommodation_budget,
(SELECT so.option_code FROM user_surveys us JOIN user_survey_answers usa ON usa.survey_id = us.id JOIN survey_options so ON so.id = usa.option_id JOIN survey_questions sq ON sq.id = so.question_id WHERE us.id = AND sq.question_code = 'PRIORITY_FACTOR' ORDER BY usa.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS priority_option_code, (SELECT so.option_name FROM user_surveys us JOIN user_survey_answers usa ON usa.survey_id = us.id JOIN survey_options so ON so.id = usa.option_id JOIN survey_questions sq ON sq.id = so.question_id WHERE us.id = AND sq.question_code = 'PRIORITY_FACTOR' ORDER BY usa.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS priority_option_name FROM workations w WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY w.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.rating, m.latitude, m.longitude FROM merchants m WHERE m.region_id = #{regionId} AND m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reservation_products rp JOIN product_daily_inventories pdi ON pdi.product_id = rp.id WHERE rp.merchant_id = m.id AND rp.product_detail_type = 'ROOM' AND pdi.inventory_date >= #{startDate} AND pdi.inventory_date < #{endDate} GROUP BY rp.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pdi.inventory_date) = DATEDIFF(#{endDate}, #{startDate}) AND MIN(CASE WHEN pdi.is_available = 1 AND pdi.remaining_capacity > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 ) ORDER BY m.id ASC

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category, m.latitude, m.longitude, 1 AS reserved FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rp.merchant_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.workation_id = #{workationId} AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND m.category = 'OFFICE' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category, m.latitude, m.longitude, 1 AS reserved FROM merchants m WHERE m.region_id = #{regionId} AND m.category = 'OFFICE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.workation_id = #{workationId} AND r.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') AND rp.merchant_id = m.id) ORDER BY m.id ASC
